project_vibe: Nostalgic 1970s Toy meets Modern Maker/Blueprint Tool. Playful yet precise. Tactile, chunky, and structurally sound.

headings.usage: Bold, chunky, oversized headings reminiscent of 1970s plastic toy packaging. NEVER use generic fonts like Inter.

body_and_technical.usage: Used for all technical data, warnings, note mappings, and file information. Creates the contrast of a 'maker blueprint'.

typography.setup_instructions: Add Google Fonts imports for 'Outfit' and 'JetBrains Mono' to index.css.

colors.notes: Colors are inspired by 1970s Fisher-Price plastics (Red, Mustard) combined with blueprint inks (Navy, Steel Blue).

surfaces.description: Containers, buttons, and form inputs must look physical and chunky.

textures.background: Use a subtle SVG noise/grain overlay on the main background to simulate matte plastic/paper texture.

layouts.description: High-tension, asymmetrical grid. No generic centered 'SaaS' containers. The layout should look like a mechanical workshop station.
layouts.grid_classes: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-6 p-6 md:p-12

regions.header: col-span-12 flex justify-between items-end border-b-4 border-[#1D3557] pb-6 mb-8
regions.viewer_3d: col-span-12 lg:col-span-8 bg-[#F4F1EA] border-2 border-[#1D3557] shadow-inner rounded-2xl overflow-hidden min-h-[60vh] relative
regions.warnings_panel: col-span-12 bg-[#FFB703] border-2 border-[#1D3557] shadow-[4px_4px_0_0_#1D3557] rounded-xl p-6 font-mono text-sm

3d_libraries.strategy: The 3D viewer is the hero of the app. It must be interactive (OrbitControls) and tactile.
3d_libraries.lighting: Use a mix of AmbientLight (intensity: 0.5) and DirectionalLight (intensity: 1, position: [5, 5, 5]) with castShadow to highlight the raised bumps (notes) on the record.
3d_libraries.material: Use meshStandardMaterial for the record. Color: '#E63946' (Plastic Red). Roughness: 0.3, Metalness: 0.1 to give it a manufactured, injection-molded plastic sheen.

component_instructions.buttons: Must be extremely chunky. Use the visual_enhancers surface classes. Action buttons (Download STL) should be Primary color. Secondary buttons (Upload MIDI) should be Mustard or White.
component_instructions.file_upload: Drag and drop zone should be a dashed box with thick borders (border-4 border-dashed border-[#457B9D] bg-white p-12 text-center).
component_instructions.warnings_list: List missing/unmappable notes in a strict technical monospace layout, aligned left. Use small badges for note names.
component_instructions.toggle_switches: Replace generic checkboxes with chunky custom toggle switches mimicking physical toy switches.
component_instructions.shadcn_overrides: When using Shadcn UI (e.g., Sliders for repeats), override their delicate Vercel aesthetics with thick 2px borders, deep navy colors, and large thumb controls.

motion.interactions: Physical 'snap' animations. Buttons should press down slightly on active: active:translate-y-1 active:shadow-[2px_2px_0_0_#1D3557].
motion.transitions: Use specific properties (transition: transform 0.15s ease-out, box-shadow 0.15s ease-out). DO NOT use 'transition-all' universally.

accessibility.contrast: All text against the off-white or white backgrounds must use #1D3557 to easily pass WCAG AA/AAA. Warnings on Mustard use #1D3557.
accessibility.data_testid: MANDATORY. Every button, input, toggle, and key section must have a data-testid. Examples: 'midi-upload-zone', 'download-stl-button', 'transpose-toggle'.

image_urls.description: Vintage record player. Use in the upload area or empty state as a nostalgic background image (with heavy opacity reduction: opacity-20 blend-multiply).
Macro shot of a 3D printer. Use for the loading/processing screen while the STL is being generated.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: CRITICAL: Write all React components in .js files, NOT .tsx files. Use standard JSX syntax.

You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Do not make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling. Embrace asymmetry and chunky geometry.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e., do not add .App { text-align: center; }.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡 for icons. Use lucide-react or phosphor-icons.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Always apply 'data-testid' to interactive elements for testing.
